steps.title: Create SoundManager class
steps.description: Implement SoundManager.java to generate standard synthesizer tone effects like success, error, and general buttons feedback using standard Android ToneGenerator API.

steps.title: Integrate sounds into Dashboard Navigation
steps.description: Modify MainActivity.java to invoke clicking sound feedback when user interacts with analytical reports, ledger, or products lists.

steps.title: Integrate sounds into Transactions processing
steps.description: Configure SalesActivity.java to play confirmation/success sounds upon transaction logging and warning tones when error validation or low stock limit blocks a transaction.

steps.title: Integrate sounds into Product creation wizard
steps.description: Update AddEditProductActivity.java to notify the manager using audible warnings when inputs are invalid and pleasant audio cues when data inserts are recorded.

steps.title: Integrate sounds into Product deletion workflow
steps.description: Update ProductListActivity.java to play standard auditory feedback when records are safely deleted from the relational storage system.

steps.title: Verify Java 8 compatibility compliance
steps.description: Ensure SoundManager static code structures avoid any Java 9+ functional interfaces or complex lambda mappings for compilation stability.

steps.title: Examine App Metadata structure
steps.description: Confirm root meta structures in app-meta.json correctly retain identity properties for Inventory & Sales Manager.

steps.title: Ensure Android Manifest consistency
steps.description: Validate AndroidManifest.xml package and component registration alignments with standard system permissions.

steps.title: Review overall Gradle compilation parameters
steps.description: Analyze target compatibility, standard SDK targets, and resource options across all gradle projects.

steps.title: Building Inventory & Sales Manager
steps.description: Trigger the build toolchain execution utilizing standard assembler to bundle sound enhancements successfully.
